svg.title: Ulanqab relative to Beijing and Hohhot
svg.desc: A north-up locator map of northern China. Ulanqab city reference point is about 300 kilometres northwest of Beijing and about 125 kilometres east of Hohhot. Lines show straight-line city distances, not transport routes or the Galaxy campus location.

g.text: Approximate straight-line distances between city reference points
